scripts.build: cargo build --workspace && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol-wasm build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/cli build
scripts.build:example: pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- build --project examples/basic
scripts.dev:once: pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- dev --project examples/basic --once --request-path /posts/abc
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol-wasm typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/cli typecheck
scripts.render:fixture: pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && node examples/basic/render.mjs | cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- render --input -
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=1 && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol test && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol-wasm test && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime test && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node test && pnpm --filter @ferrite/cli test && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:example && pnpm test:demos
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol-wasm build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:example: pnpm build:example && pnpm render:fixture && pnpm dev:once && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- serve --project examples/basic --artifact .ferrite/build --page-renderer packages/runtime/bin/render-artifact.mjs --once --request-path /posts/abc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/protocol-wasm typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/cli typecheck && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- check --project examples/basic && pnpm check:demos
